definitions.primary_runtime: Arithmetic mean of original trial runtimes; infoflow uses scenarios.
definitions.primary_cost: Arithmetic mean cost per trial; infoflow uses scenarios.
definitions.supplement: All original observations retained, including long network waits. Median and ranges are supplementary descriptive statistics.
definitions.cost_scope: Tau2 agent plus simulated-user cost; MALADE and infoflow use reported total_cost.

validation.pooled_cost: Total cost divided by total observations
